name: MVTec AD: MVTec Anomaly Detection Dataset
description: Foundational benchmark dataset for unsupervised visual anomaly detection and localization in industrial quality inspection. Contains 5,354 high-resolution color images across 15 real-world industrial categories (5 textures and 10 objects). Provides 3,629 anomaly-free images for training and 1,725 test images (467 normal and 1,258 defective) showcasing 73 different defect types with pixel-precise ground truth segmentation masks.
